matching_pages_notes: The original 63 matching pages were reviewed in nine labeled contact sheets at original detail. Pages 20 and 21 were subsequently rendered at 300 dpi and inspected at original resolution. Across all 65 pages, table structure, headers, footers, row boundaries, names, grades or ranks, identifier-column occupancy, boxes, and location columns matched the embedded-text extraction.
